question: What will Rosstat report as Russia's average retail price of AI-95 gasoline in the weekly fuel-price release covering data through mid-October 2026?

calls.reasoning: Rosstat AI-95 national average was 80.80 on Sept 28 after +0.18, +0.01, +0.01 weekly moves, i.e. the summer surge (69.78 on Jun 1, ~+0.3-0.4/wk) has stalled, with declines in 22 regions in the latest week. Two more weekly prints to the Oct 12 reference date. Status quo is small creep; upside risks come from continued refinery drone strikes, near-record exchange prices and autumn maintenance; downside is limited because the national average rarely falls week-on-week. Median ~80.91, right-skewed; a ~3% tail above 81.505 would need a summer-pace re-acceleration. No human market found (Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmakers).
calls.dossier:
- Rosstat weekly AI-95 national avg (resolution series): 80.60 (Sep 7), 80.78 (Sep 14), 80.79 (Sep 21), 80.80 (Sep 28) [question background; AK&M and regions.ru, Oct 1 2026]. The week to Sep 28 had declines in 22 regions; AI-92 fell slightly, diesel fell 0.6%, AI-98+ was 103.63 and diesel 86.77 [regions.ru/AK&M, Oct 1 2026].
- Earlier level: AI-95 was 69.78 on Jun 1 2026 (+0.46% that week, accelerating from +0.34%) [neftegaz.ru, Jun 4 2026]. So weekly gains ran ~+0.3-0.4 RUB from Jun to early Sep, then slowed to ~+0.01/wk in late Sep.
- Exchange: AI-95 on the St Petersburg exchange was near record highs; a price corridor caps daily exchange increases; mandatory exchange-sales quota was cut to 10% through Sep 2026 [neftegaz.ru, early Oct 2026 page].
- Drivers per the question background: drone strikes on refineries (Volgograd, Samara-area pipeline, early Oct), autumn maintenance, a gasoline export ban to Jan 31 2027, and the diesel export ban to Oct 31. Offsets: >1m bbl of seaborne gasoline imports; officials expect stabilization in October.
- Status quo: flat to small weekly creep. Two weekly prints remain (refs Oct 5 and Oct 12). Resolves off the Rosstat weekly release with reference date Oct 12 2026, not third-party trackers (driff/globalpetrolprices show different numbers).
- Event window: reference date Oct 12 2026 (published ~Oct 14-15); as of Oct 5, 2 of the remaining weekly changes are still unobserved.
- Searched for but could not find: the Oct 5-reference print (not yet published) or any prediction market.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs share the same facts: Rosstat 80.80 on 28 Sep, two prints remaining, no market found. One dossier said '+0.1%' for the latest week, but 80.79->80.80 is ~0.01%, which does not affect the forecast. The only differences are judgment about drift (medians 80.86-80.91) and tail width. I lean slightly above the flattest runs because the early-Oct refinery strikes came after the last print, but I keep the median near the plateau because exchange caps and imports restrain retail prices. Dispersion is similar to the runs' ~0.33-0.38. No web retrieval on this run.
